title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge Pro. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.
The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details: Fixed in Bridge Pro firmware version 6.1.2071524030 (or later) https://www.philips-hue.com/en-ca/support/release-notes/bridge-pro
